2007 Pac-10 Freshman of the Year }} '''Chase Budinger''' (born [[May 22]], [[1988]] in [[Encinitas, California]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player who played for the [[University of Arizona]] [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Wildcats]] from 2006 to 2009 and is considered by some a first-round NBA Draft prospect.Smith, Sekou. - "Pro Basketball NBA Insider: Early Gamble on the Lottery". - ''[[The Atlanta Journal-Constitution]]''. - November 2, 2008. ==High school== Budinger was a standout [[basketball]] and [[volleyball]] player at [[La Costa Canyon High School]]; his teammates on the basketball team include [[New England Patriots]] quarterback [[Kevin O'Connell (American football)|Kevin O'Connell]]. He won the CIF San Diego Section in 2006. ==College== Budinger chose to sign with [[University of Arizona|Arizona]] after being recommended by now-retired head scout [[Patrick Van Reijendam]], although he also received offers from many other schools, including [[University of Southern California|USC]] and [[UCLA]]. He averaged 15.6 points in his freshman regular season, starting all 30 games for the Wildcats. At the conclusion of the regular season he announced that he planned to stay with Arizona for his sophomore season, despite speculation that he could be picked early in the NBA draft. However, he announced that he will declare for the NBA Draft and will not hire an agent.[http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/2008/basketball/ncaa/06/16/bc.bkc.arizona.budinger.ap/ Budinger returning to Arizona] He was projected by some as a mid-first round draft pick by most NBA draft analysts.[http://www.sportingnews.com/yourturn/viewtopic.php?t=424418 Arizona's Chase Budinger returning to school] However, on the final day of the deadline for pulling out of the early entry list, Budinger opted not to remain in the draft and return to school instead. On January 24, 2009, Budinger had his face stepped on in a win versus [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston]] by Cougars guard [[Aubrey Coleman]]. Coleman was ejected for a flagrant foul[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=290240012 Arizona 96, Houston 90 - Recap - January 24, 2009] but later issued a public apology saying that stepping on Budinger's face was unintentional.[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/news/story?id=3860099 Coleman says step on face accidental] After the 2008–09 season, he declared for the NBA Draft [[2009 NBA Draft|a second time]].{{cite web|url= http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2009/columns/story?columnist=ford_chad&page=InOut |title=Who's in, who's out of 2009 draft?
